prompt: Compose an email to a colleague who shared an unfinished draft too late for a thorough review. Explain what feedback you can still provide before the deadline. Keep your response near 80 words.
text:
Subject: Quick Feedback Before Deadline

Hi [Name],

Thanks for sharing the draft. Given the timing, I can’t do a full review before the deadline, but I can still provide a quick pass for major issues: overall clarity, key gaps, factual inconsistencies, and any sections that may need clearer framing. I can also flag obvious grammar or formatting problems, though I won’t be able to line-edit every section. Send me the latest version and I’ll return high-priority comments as soon as possible.

Best,  
[Your Name]
